# gmac-wan: a DSA switch (MediaTek MT7621 class) plus a second GMAC that is
# the case's WAN socket. The access point uses that socket as a LAN uplink, so
# wan is a bridge member (brport/, upper_br-lan, master): its role stays
# "wan" because board.json names it so. wan's label is in its own of_node.
# eth0 is the DSA conduit; lan1-lan4 are user ports, lan1 negotiated
# 100 Mb/s, lan2 and lan3 have no cable. The bridge (which has brif/, not to
# be confused with a member's brport/), a VLAN on it and three wireless
# interfaces are noise.
#
# Format: see loadTree in ports_test.go.

-- etc/board.json --
{
	"model": {
		"id": "example,gmac-wan",
		"name": "Example GMAC-WAN router"
	},
	"led": {
		"wan": {
			"name": "WAN",
			"sysfs": "green:wan",
			"type": "netdev",
			"device": "wan",
			"mode": "link tx rx"
		}
	},
	"network": {
		"lan": {
			"ports": [
				"lan1",
				"lan2",
				"lan3",
				"lan4"
			],
			"protocol": "static"
		},
		"wan": {
			"device": "wan",
			"protocol": "dhcp"
		}
	},
	"system": {
		"compat_version": "1.1"
	}
}

-- sys/class/net/br-lan/ --
type=1
ifindex=8
iflink=8
flags=0x1003
carrier=1
carrier_changes=6
operstate=up
speed=1000
duplex=unknown
address=02:00:00:00:02:0c
mtu=1500
uevent=DEVTYPE=bridge\nINTERFACE=br-lan\nIFINDEX=8
bridge/forward_delay=1500
brif/lan1
brif/lan2
brif/lan3
brif/lan4
brif/phy0-ap0
brif/phy1-ap0
brif/phy1-ap1
brif/wan
upper_br-lan.1
lower_lan1
lower_lan2
lower_lan3
lower_lan4
lower_phy0-ap0
lower_phy1-ap0
lower_phy1-ap1
lower_wan

-- sys/class/net/eth0/ --
type=1
ifindex=2
iflink=2
flags=0x1003
carrier=1
carrier_changes=1
operstate=up
speed=1000
duplex=full
address=02:00:00:00:02:0c
mtu=1504
uevent=OF_NAME=mac\nOF_FULLNAME=/ethernet/mac@0\nOF_COMPATIBLE_0=mediatek,eth-mac\nOF_COMPATIBLE_N=1\nINTERFACE=eth0\nIFINDEX=2
dsa/tagging=mtk
upper_lan1
upper_lan2
upper_lan3
upper_lan4
of_node/compatible=mediatek,eth-mac\0
device/uevent=DRIVER=mtk_soc_eth\nOF_NAME=ethernet
device/driver -> ../../../bus/platform/drivers/mtk_soc_eth
